summary: FAIL. Most of DG1 verifies on the frozen candidate: frozen offline install, typecheck/build/lint/openapi/no-cdn/contrast, 130 unit tests, migrations on fresh DBs, append-only audit, A12/A13/A14, A20 (bilingual shell, token propagation), 20 EN/AR e2e journeys with 0 axe violations, branding API/fonts/wordmark (new independent spec), workspace clean start (A18), worker stop. Two High defects block approval: the integration contract suite is red because getBrandingTokens is not exercised (F-DG1-201, REQ-S19-006), and the shipped runtime layout/container image cannot start the API because @mth/design-tokens is not assembled (F-DG1-202). Plus CI images job red on unpinned digests (Medium, F-DG1-203) and four Low items. Compose path, live CI and registry-only egress are BLOCKED (no Docker daemon/network).
